Photo sharing: daily challenge, 2026-12-08

The shared System Designer challenge for 2026-12-08: Photo sharing. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

You are building a photo app. People post pictures and everyone else scrolls through them. Almost all the traffic is people looking at photos, and the photos take up far more room than anything else you store.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
